notes: Crash screen cleanup: when the game fails to start the raw log no longer floods the home screen; the error stays a single line and details live in the crash report, with the raw log behind a toggle. Missing dependencies Fabric prints without quotes (e.g. yet_another_config_lib_v3) are now found on Modrinth and installed automatically. The profile content tab gained a mod search bar, per-mod delete and .jar add. Windows and Linux builds are available.
